verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say its APIs expose customer, account, payment, card and transaction data with real-time balances, and it publishes webhooks and an llms.txt. That covers the core account and transaction read path without needing the dashboard. However, the evidence is marketing-level: no MCP server is evidenced, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all probe paths returned 404), and pending activity and documents are not explicitly covered. Missing for 10: an MCP surface, a published OpenAPI spec or detailed API reference, explicit access to pending transactions, document/statement retrieval, and independent hands-on corroboration.
